data.name: Khumar
data.gender_notes: Khumar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A mountain or hill in Arabic context, representing strength and resilience. Khumar is often associated with stability and endurance. In Islamic tradition, it symbolizes a connection to the divine. The name Khumar carries the meaning “Mount or hill” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khumar usually hope their child will grow to embody mount or hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual mount for the faithful, connecting with the divine and the heavens.
data.etymology: Khumar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mount or hill.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khumar total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
